Earlier, after enabling iPhone users to add a second account within the same application, WhatsApp is now developing support for up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp will support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same application.

This feature was officially released after several months of beta testing, eliminating the need for users to rely on WhatsApp Business as an alternative for managing a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, the application appears to be developing an expansion of this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report added that each account will retain its own conversation history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo pointed out that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who have different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

That said, this feature is still in the development stage and has not yet been made available to beta testers, meaning it may still be some time before a wider rollout.
